title: Look to Jesus
lyrics: Verse 1:
[E]When the devil comes in, comes in like a flood,
[E]Wh[F#m]en d[B]arkness surrounds you and cannot look up,
[E]Wh[F#m]en heartache and sorrow will never seem done,
[E]Lo[B]ok[E] to Jesus, who's already run.
Chorus 1:
[B]Lo[A]ok[E] to Jesus, who's already run.
[B]Lo[A]ok[E] to Jesus, the Glorified Son.
[B]Lo[B/C]ok t[C#m]o Jesu[F#]s, who said, 'It is done.'
[A]Lo[B]ok[E] to Jesus, who's already won.
Verse 2:
[E]As witnesses call us again to go on
[E]To[F#m] a l[B]ife that will count for eternity on,
[E]Mo[F#m]ve forward by faith and lay the sin aside,
[E]Lo[B]ok[E] to Jesus, who's already run.
Verse 3:
[E]Can you see him in glory, on His throne of grace?
[E]Ha[F#m]ve y[B]ou seen our Lord suffering, despising the shame?
[E]Co[F#m]nsider the cost in redeeming the lost?
[E]Lo[B]ok[E] to Jesus, who finished His race.
Chorus 2:
[B]Lo[A]ok[E] to Jesus, the author of faith.
[B]Lo[A]ok[E] to Jesus, the giver of grace.
[B]Lo[B/C]ok t[C#m]o Jesu[F#]s, and finish your race.
[A]Lo[B]ok[E] to Jesus, who's already won.
Chorus 3:
[B]Lo[A]ok[E] to Jesus, who sits on the throne.
[B]Lo[A]ok[E] to Jesus, who calls me His own.
[B]Lo[B/C]ok t[C#m]o Jesu[F#]s and heaven, our home.
[A]Lo[B]ok[E] to Jesus, who's already won.
